title: Tom's Free Time
text:
Tom likes to play football on Saturdays. He plays with his friends in the park. After the game, they eat ice cream together. Tom likes his free time because he can relax.

On Sunday, Tom reads books in his room. His favourite book is about animals. Sometimes his sister Ana draws pictures with him. They have fun together.

paragraph_translations: Tom gosta de jogar futebol aos sábados. Ele joga com os amigos no parque. Depois do jogo, eles comem sorvete juntos. Tom gosta do tempo livre porque pode relaxar.
No domingo, Tom lê livros no quarto. O livro favorito dele é sobre animais. Às vezes, a irmã dele, Ana, desenha figuras com ele. Eles se divertem juntos.
